senses.gloss: m. (prob. a transpos. of נטף, a readaptation of νάφθα) naphtha.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 26a:4">Ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מדליקין בנ׳ לבן וכ׳</he> white naphtha must not be used for lighting … because it is explosive.
<cite ref="Shabbat 26a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה יעשו … אלא נ׳</he> and what shall the Cappadocians do who have … only naphtha? <cite ref="Yoma 38b:16">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite>, sq.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:2:3">Y. Snh. VII, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. (v. <cite ref="U02014"><he>שְׂרֵפָה</he></cite>) <he>בפתילה של נ׳</he> the Mishnah, describing capital punishment by burning, means a wick saturated with naphtha. Y. Sot. VII, beg. 22ᵇ <he>אש כנגד נ׳ שלהן</he> ‘fire’ (<cite ref="Psalms 18:13">Ps. XVIII, 13</cite>) corresponds to the arrows of the human armies tipped in naphtha; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 17:1">Pesik. R. s. 17</cite> <he>רמה בהן נ׳</he> he (the besieger) throws naphtha &c. (βέλη πυροφόρα or πυροβόλα).
